briefings.tldr: The 2016 AlphaGo match against Lee Sedol marked the shift from AI as a tool for brute-force calculation to a system capable of creative intuition, establishing the reinforcement learning and search-space navigation techniques now used to solve grand scientific challenges like protein folding and mathematical proofs.
